plan.title: Afterimage
plan.blurb: The photograph explores the threshold between grounding and suspension. Heavy stones, naturally bound to the earth, appear weightless as they hover above the surface. Their shadows become traces of where they belong, creating a tension between presence and absence, stability and movement. The space between each stone and its shadow becomes the threshold itself, a moment between being grounded and being free.

plan.title: Afterglow
plan.blurb: A flame disappears, yet its presence lingers. Smoke dances through the darkness, tracing the memory of a light that once was. Suspended between existence and absence, it becomes a reminder that endings are rarely absolute. Even in disappearance, something remains, a final breath, a fading trace, an echo of what once existed. A quiet reminder that crossing a threshold does not always mean leaving something behind, but transforming into something new.
plan.subject: (where & what it is)
